p.d: 17 августа 2008 года. В 5 часов утра в Перми произошла авиакатастрофа. Пассажирский Боинг рухнул в жилой части города. При этом на земле никто не пострадал. На борту самолета находилось 88 человек. Ни одного тела не было найдено.Что стало причиной авиакатастрофы с такими странными последствиями? Пермская аномалия?
Это серия документальных фильмов, посвященных великим императорам, царям и царицам, князьям Российской империи.

Slimnīcā ievests pusaudzis Stīvijs ar smagiem elpošanas traucējumiem un iekšēju asiņošanu. Hauss tiek norīkots par viņa ārstu, tomēr viņš ir aizņemts ar Kadijas uzdotu uzdevumu. Kad mediķiem rodas problēmas ar Stīvija vecākiem, kuri iejaucas ārstniecībā, Formens ir spiests riskēt ar savu ārsta licenci un lūgt Stīvijam melot vecākiem.

Autoavārijā iekļuvusi meitene, kura cieš no slimības, kas neļauj viņai just sāpes. Pēc pārbaužu veikšanas viņai sākas spēcīgs drudzis, lēkmes, un viņas stāvoklis strauji pasliktinās. Hauss ar komandu mēģina saprast, kas meitenei īsti kaiš, lai glābtu viņas dzīvību.

Kurš gan nezina Reksi - lielisko policistu palīgu. Nu iepazīstieties ar Aleksu! Vācu aitu suns Alekss ir labākais izmeklētājs visā Polijas policijā. Tomēr pēc Aleksa drauga un kolēģa nāves policistu starpā rodas šaubas, vai suns spēs pārvarēt lielās sirdssāpes. Par laimi, jaunais komisārs Mareks Bromskis spēj iekarot viņa uzticību, un suņu puika atkal luncina asti un ir gatavs mesties noziedzniekiem pa pēdām. Alekss pat sadraudzējas ar Mareka izveicīgo kolēģi Lūsiju, kura ir nesen šķīrusies un viena audzina savus dvīņu puikas. Policijā darba netrūkst nekad, un ar Aleksu pie sāniem Mareks un viņa komanda ir gatavi stāties pretī jebkuram pārbaudījumam.

p.t: Cipars vai ģerbonis. Ivļejeva pret Bedņakovu
p.d: Katrs raidījums stāsta par vienu valsti vai pilsētu no divām perspektīvām – kā savu maršrutu mēro cilvēks ar neierobežotu budžetu un ļoti taupīgs ceļotājs.

Dokumentālais kultūras un ceļojumu šovs atgriežas ar aizraujošu devīto sezonu, aicinot skatītājus doties pasaules neparastākajos dzelzceļa maršrutos. No vēsturiskiem tvaika dzinējiem līdz moderniem ātrvilcieniem - katrs brauciens atklāj satriecošas dabas ainavas un unikālas vietējās kopienas. Šajā sezonā kopā ar harizmātisko vadītāju skatītāji nonāks tādās kontrastējošās vietās kā eksotiskā Kambodža, skarbā un skaistā Zviedrijas ziemeļu daba, kā arī krāšņā Vidusjūras pērle Sicīlija. Kāp uz borta un piedzīvo pasauli no cita skatu punkta, kur pats ceļojums ir galamērķis!

Erudīcijas spēle katram darbdienu vakaram! Katru vakaru 15 jautājumi, viens uzvarētājs un 150 eiro balva. Spēli vada radio personība, dīdžejs un pasākumu vadītājs Magnuss Eriņš, bet par vakara erudītākā cilvēka titulu sacenšas divi dalībnieki. Noteikumi ir pavisam vienkārši - katram dalībniekam priekšā ir poga, kas kļūst aktīva, līdzko izskanējis jautājums. Kurš pirmais šo pogu nospiež, tas izvēlas jautājuma likteni - vai pats vēlas uz to atbildēt cerībā nopelnīt divus punktus, vai arī pirmo iespēju dot konkurentam, lai pats pēc tam mēģinātu tikt pie viena punkta. Kurš atbildējis pirmais un pareizi, tas tiek pie diviem punktiem, kurš otrais - pie viena, bet par nepareizu atbildi punkti nepienākas. Kuram vakara beigās vairāk punktu, tas arī uzvarētājs! Uzvarētājs saņem 150 eiro balvu un iespēju piedalīties nākamā vakara spēlē.
Sadursme 360 ir 10 minūšu ikdienas operatīvo drošības dienestu ziņu raidījums ar galveno uzsvaru uz ceļu satiksmes drošību.

Jau no pirmās nedēļas erudīcijas spēle "Viens pret visiem" sola intrigu līdz pat finālam, kurā noskaidrosies galvenais - vai uzvarēs viens drosmīgais spēlētājs vai slavenības komanda, kurā šonedēļ apvienosies erudīti Liene Mekša un Kristaps Rozītis, kā arī aktieris Jānis Āmanis. No pirmdienas līdz ceturtdienai viens spēlētājs sacentīsies ar trim pretiniekiem, sākot spēli ar nelielu priekšrocību. Pirmajā kārtā viņš varēs izvēlēties sev tuvāko tēmu un par pareizu atbildi iegūt divus punktus. Turpmāk spēlētājs joprojām saglabās kontroli pār tēmu izvēli - viņš noteiks ne tikai jautājumu sev, bet arī to, ar kuru tēmu būs jāsacenšas pretiniekam. Kad spēlē iesaistīsies visi trīs eksperti, sāksies "Viens pret visiem" cīņa. Kurš izrādīsies zinošāks un veiksmīgāks - viens spēlētājs vai trīs pretinieku komanda? To noskaidrosim jau pirmajā spēles nedēļā!

Pirmajā raidījuma nedēļā savu mājokļu durvis skatītājiem un pārējiem dalībniekiem vērs aktrise Linda Kalniņa, dziedātāja un sevis pa laikam par multimākslinieci dēvētā Nansija Garkalne, kā arī aktieris Rihards Lepers, kurš, starp citu, sevi nekā citādi nedēvē. Savukārt ceturtais šīs kompānijas dalībnieks brīvdomātājs un mūziķis Horens Stalbe viesus uzņems visai ekstravaganti, sagaidot viņus... halātā! Taču ar to Horena pārsteigumi nebeigsies. Tā vietā, lai aicinātu slavenības uz savām mājām, viņš nolēmis vakariņas rīkot viesnīcā. Tas, protams, raisīs jautājumus pārējo dalībnieku vidū - vai Horenu tiešām izmeta no mājām vai varbūt viesnīca ir viņa paša miera templis? Arī vakariņu ēdienkartē netrūks pārsteigumu, tiesa, ne visi būs patīkami - izrādīsies, ka Nansija Garkalne nebūt nav zivju ēdienu cienītāja.

Leipcigas policijas īpašā vienība SOKO - labākie no labākajiem, augstas klases profesionāļi, izmeklētāji, kas ķeras pie darba, lai atrisinātu smagākos un sarežģītākos pilsētā paveiktos noziegumus. Vienību vada ambiciozā vecākā policijas komisāre Ina Cimermane, kas kopā ar savu uzticamo komandu Janu Meibahu, Tomu Kovalski un Olīviju Faredi izmeklē smagus noziegumus - gan rūpīgi plānotas slepkavības, gan emociju karstumā paveiktas. Lai notvertu noziedzniekus, komanda piesaista valsts izcilākos ekspertus un labākos konsultantus.

Galveno nozieguma pierādījumu asiņainu nazi tiesas prāvā par kādas 19 gadus jaunas meitenes izvarošanu un noslepkavošanu tiesnesis atzīst par nederīgu, jo tas no apsūdzētā mašīnas paņemts bez ordera. Līdz nākamajai tiesas sēdei apsūdzētais tiek atbrīvots. CSI izmeklētājiem ir 24 stundas, lai pierādītu viņa vainu.

Ieskaties vienas no Austrālijas lielākās un noslogotākās medicīnas iestādes, Melburnas Karaliskās slimnīcas, neatliekamās palīdzības nodaļas ikdienā. Nežēlīgi uzbrukumi, šausminošas avārijas, traumatiski negadījumi un katastrofas - katru dienu slimnīcā nonāk cilvēki ar dzīvībai bīstamiem ievainojumiem. Tad pie darba ķeras augsti kvalificēti ārsti un medmāsas un nenogurstoši cīnās par savu pacientu dzīvībām. Spriedze, emocijas, brīnumainas izglābšanās un traģiski zaudējumi - aiz šīs slimnīcas sienām notiek it viss. Sāpju asaras mijas ar laimīgiem smaidiem.

Maroka pievārēta, laiks jauniem piedzīvojumiem - Samantai Tīnai un Laurim Reinikam pievienojas influenceris Armands Jaunzems un fitnesa skaistule Juta Valdmane. Jautrā četrotne dodas uz Gruziju. Pirmā diena Armanda rokās, kurš, ierodoties Tbilisī, ap 4 naktī nolemj, ka miegam nav vietas, izklaides jāsāk nekavējoties. Grupas biedru nepatika pret šādu lēmumu netiek slēpta. Protestu rezultātā uzvar miegs, grupa dodas nedaudz pagulēt. Taču izrādās, ka arī tas nav viegli - Armands ir atradis dzīvokli Tbilisi, kura adresi nezina pat taksometra šoferis. Vai naktsmājas vispār tiks atrastas?

Slavenā NCIS Losandželosas īpašā vienība ķeras pie darba! Augsti kvalificēti, pieredzējuši un spējīgi - viņi tiek piesaistīti lietās, kurās uz spēles ir valsts drošība. Komandu vada augumā necilā, tomēr ļoti spējīgā Hetija, kuras apskaužamās zināšanas, skarbā attieksme un ciešais skatiens iedveš bailes kā noziedzniekiem, tā viņas padotajiem. Īpašais aģents Džī Kalens iepriekš stradājis FIB, Narkotiku apkarošanas administrācijā un Centrālajā izlūkošanas pārvaldē, bet viņa pārinieks Sems Hanna ir ar militāru un sporta pieredzi, un kopā ar savu uzticamo komandu viņi ir neapturami un spēj aizturēt pat visrūdītākos noziedzniekus.

Īpašā izmeklētāju vienība detektīva Maka Teilora vadībā šķetina noziegumus tumšākajos Ņujorkas nostūros. Viņi ir kā savdabīga ģimene, kurus vieno spēcīga taisnīguma izjūta. Lai atklātu sarežģītās krimināllietas, viņi izmanto progresīvākās metodes, pretstatā tradicionālajiem izmeklēšanas paņēmieniem. Katra ir lieta kā rēbuss, kuru komanda risina, analizējot katru detaļu un pavedienu.

Garšīgais ciemošanās šovs "Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas" atkal priecē skatītājus! Četri dalībnieki nedēļas garumā cits pie cita viesosies, gatavos vakariņas un centīsies pārsteigt ar gardiem ēdieniem, radošām idejām un īpašu vakara noskaņu. Taču ne vienmēr viss noritēs pēc plāna - amizanti starpgadījumi un negaidīti pārsteigumi būs daļa no vakariņu šarma. Šova jaunajā sezonā savas mājokļu durvis vērs sabiedrībā zināmas personības, bet katra vakara noslēgumā viesi vērtēs gan ēdienus, gan radīto gaisotni. Pēc četriem vakariem augstāko punktu skaitu ieguvušais dalībnieks kļūs par nedēļas uzvarētāju un saņems vērtīgu balvu. Skatītājus sagaida sirsnīgas tikšanās, humors, pārsteigumi un iespēja ielūkoties iemīļotu personību ikdienā - šoreiz nevis uz skatuves vai ekrānā, bet pie vakariņu galda.
Sadursme 360 ir 10 minūšu ikdienas operatīvo drošības dienestu ziņu raidījums ar galveno uzsvaru uz ceļu satiksmes drošību.

360 Ziņas ir dinamisks un mūsdienīgs TOP7 dienas svarīgāko Latvijas un pasaules notikumu apskats, kas palīdz saprast, kāpēc tas ir svarīgi tieši tev. TOP7 apvieno ātru tempu, saprotamu valodu, dažādus viedokļus un cilvēku pieredzes, kā arī skaidrojošu pieeju bez informācijas pārslodzes un liekvārdības, palīdzot orientēties informatīvajā troksnī un īsā laikā ar TOP7 iegūt skaidru priekšstatu par dienas būtiskāko.

Kad policija ir bezspēcīga, palīgā dodas Īpašā izmeklēšanas aģentūra SLED. Tā ir īpaši izveidota struktūra policijas galvenās pārvaldes sastāvā un tieši pakļauta ģenerālim - Ukrainas Iekšlietu ministra vietniekam. Vienība nodarbojas ar īpaši skaļu, sarežģītu un smagu noziegumu izmeklēšanu. Tai pieejamas vismodernākās tehnoloģijas un valsts labākie kriminālisti un tiesu medicīnas laboratorijas. Protams, vienībā darbojas arī tikai labākie operatīvie darbinieki, kuri nepieļaus, ka kāda lieta netiktu atrisināta. Galvenajās lomās: Tatjana Kravčenko, Boriss Georgijevskijs, Aleksejs Surovcevs.

Bijusī izmeklētāja Nataļja Dzjubenko un žurnālists Vadims Zorons turpina cīņu taisnības vārdā! Kopā ar saviem profesionālajiem palīgiem viņi izmeklē sevišķi smagus un sarežģītus noziegumus, kuru atšķetināšanā likumsargi izrādījušies bezspēcīgi. Aiz restēm mūža ieslodzījumu izcieš nežēlīgs maniaks Marks Šimičs, kurš saviem upuriem lika izvēlēties - izdarīt pašnāvību vai mirt mokošā bada nāvē. Nu kāds pastrādā noziegumus, kopējot Šimiču. Vadims dodas uz cietumu, lai tuvāk iepazītu maniaku un atrastu saikni starp abiem noziedzniekiem un notvertu ļaundari. Tā kā katrs izmeklētājs ir ar savu spēcīgu raksturu, tādu pat viedokli, un katram ir savas darba metodes, atmosfēra komandā gan kļūst nokaitēta, un sastrādāties nav nemaz tik viegli.

Nepālas ceļojums var sākties! Jau pirmajā sērijā dosimies uz visnotaļ bīstamu savvaļas vietu - Nepālas džungļiem, kur pārsteigumi gaida ik uz soļa! Raidījumā uzzināsiet, kā izvērtīsies saldās medus medības pie milzu asinskārajām bitēm un kā ar masveidīgu rituālu palīdzību iespējams apturēt sausumu, kā arī dosimies uz grandiozām svinībām Himalajos. Bet Dmitrijs Komarovs būs liecinieks nežēlīgam rituālam, kas šokēs līdz sirds dziļumiem. Kāpēc cilvēki joprojām upurē dievus, lūdzot viņiem aizsardzību un palīdzību? To uzzini piedzīvojumiem bagātajā un ekstrēmajā Nepālas ceļojumā!

Krimināli dokumentāls drāmas seriāls, kurā tiek izmeklēti sarežģīti kriminālprocesi. Katra sērija ir atsevišķs stāsts, kas balstīts uz reāliem notikumiem. Daudzi šādi noziegumi varētu palikt neatklāti un vainīgais – izvairīties no soda, ja vien izmeklētāja atklātā detaļa nekļūtu par pavedienu uz atrisinājumu: nomesta matu sprādze, pazaudēta poga vai ielikta zīmīte - lietiskie pierādījumi.

Andrejs Kravecs ir godprātīgs un principiāls operatīvais darbinieks. Tieši viņa godprātība noved pie saķeršanās ar augsti stāvošu un ietekmīgu politiķi, kurš saniknojas ne pa jokam. Lai pasargātu Andreju no neparedzamām sekām, vadība pārceļ viņu no galvaspilsētas uz dzimto Odesu. Dzimtajā pilsētā Andreju jau sagaida seni draugi – bijušais bokseris Fedja, kurš nerunā daudz, bet ir uzticams līdz kaulam, un Makss – talantīgs inženieris un programmētājs. Un šī komanda noliks pie vietas ne vienu vien Odesas noziedznieku!

Kad policija ir bezspēcīga, palīgā dodas Īpašā izmeklēšanas aģentūra SLED. Tā ir īpaši izveidota struktūra policijas galvenās pārvaldes sastāvā un tieši pakļauta ģenerālim - Ukrainas Iekšlietu ministra vietniekam. Vienība nodarbojas ar īpaši skaļu, sarežģītu un smagu noziegumu izmeklēšanu. Tai pieejamas vismodernākās tehnoloģijas un valsts labākie kriminālisti un tiesu medicīnas laboratorijas. Protams, vienībā darbojas arī tikai labākie operatīvie darbinieki, kuri nepieļaus, ka kāda lieta netiktu atrisināta. Galvenajās lomās: Tatjana Kravčenko, Boriss Georgijevskijs, Aleksejs Surovcevs.

Ieskaties noziedzības pasaulē, kur divas leģendāras komandas no seriāliem "Ūdens policija" un "Izmeklēšanas aģentūra "SLED"" apvieno spēkus, lai izmeklētu vissarežģītākos noziegumus. Šī pieredzes, zināšanu un tehnoloģiju apvienošanās kļūs par īstu izaicinājumu noziedzīgajai pasaulei. Stāsts sākas ar izmeklēšanu par vairākām skaļām ārvalstu pilsoņu slepkavībām, kas vienlaikus notikušas Karpatu reģionā un Kijevā. Vēstnieki un konsuli pieprasīja nekavējoties savervēt labākos spēkus. Detektīviem darbā palīdzēs jaudīga uz mākslīgā intelekta bāzes veidota datorprogramma K.O.D. Tā ne tikai risina sarežģītas noziedznieku mīklas, bet arī nolasa izmeklēšanas dalībnieku emocionālo stāvokli.

When Eliza (Sydney Penny) loses her father-in-law she is left to raise two children, continue work on an unharvested orange crop, and maintain a heavy mortgage. She begins to lose faith until her Aunt Batty (Shirley Jones) persuades her to persevere. Suddenly a mysterious stranger called Gabe (Jason Gedrick) turns up and helps Eliza with the harvest just in time to stop the bank from taking over. The more Eliza learns about Gabe, the more she realizes she loves him.

Frank Darnell, director of the Central Security Agency (CSA), is at a loss when Miles Crandall, the genius who writes top-secret satellite communication software for his Pentagon-contracted company, disappears from a private jet flight, apparently by parachute, over the desert. CSA vet Cathy Davis, who retired to be a mother to husband Jack ad their kids, is secretly called in to solve the riddle, ironic given her cover as game designer for the US Puzzle Co. They soon realize the escape was staged, the question remains by whom and why. Meanwhile, Nick an unpopular bright nerd runs for class secretary, his haughty sister Susan fails to join the cheerleaders.

p.t: Jane Doe: Now You See It, Now You Don't
p.d: Mystery with Lea Thompson. When the Declaration Of Independence is stolen while on display in a Los Angeles bank, puzzle solver Jane Doe is asked to help solve the case.

After a storm sent by the tyrannical sorceress Azkadellia, DG manages to escape her small town and finds herself in the dangerous underworld know as the O.Z. There she befriends three of its inhabitants: Glitch, Wyatt Cain and Raw and meets the great Mystic Man. They all help her escape from the evil sorceress who's after her.

p.t: Gentle Ben: Terror On The Mountain
p.d: When Mark goes for a visit with his uncle he's thrown into a world he knows not much about. Little does he know it'll be a world he's going to have to become very familiar with. One character Mark becomes very familiar and friendly with is a very tame black bear who he later names Ben

Twelve years after the emperor's death, the Fremen armies have successfully subdued all known planets, killing off millions in numerous battles. The desert plant Arrakis "Dune" has become an imperial capital, still thanks to its monopoly on the spice. Now Paul Muad'Dib Atreidis' son and daughter are coming of age, the stage is set for a new power game. The spice guilt has prepared a secret weapon: perfect clones.

As conspiracies to gain political power abound, Paul's power base is eroded from within and his highly ambitious sister, Alia is gaining a political foothold. Born aware of her ancestral memories, Alia is considered an abomination by the Bene Gesserit. The Lady Jessica, her mother returns to Dune (Arrakis) to visit her grandchildren Leto II and Ghanima. When one particular ancestor begins to possess Alia, Lady Jessica has to take refuge. Leto II and Ghanima devise a plan toward salvation.

As Alia becomes totally possessed she also has to deal with rebel Fremen. Ghanima, who survived an attack on her by House Corrino, is now engaged to Farad'n Corrino. Unexpectedly, Leto II returns from the desert being believed dead. While in the desert his body has absorbed some sand-trout, slowly mutating him into a sand-worm. Alia resists possession by the baron while Irulan declines Jessica's offer to return with her to Caladan.

p.t: Jane Doe: The Harder They Fall
p.d: Mystery drama about a crime-fighting sleuth with a double life. Jane Doe investigates the death of a high-powered business mogul. She quickly discovers that the man's apparent drowning was staged to look like an accident.

This re-telling of the eighteen century novel of the same name, by H. Rider Haggard, features Patrick Swayze. The main character (Swayze), is called Allan Quatermain and is a treasure hunter in search this time, of King Solomon's hidden treasure. With the help of a group of people, one of which is a woman trying to locate her father, Sir Henry, who went missing years ago, they embark on the dangerous journey. On their coat tails is a group of hostile and violent African tribesmen and a fellow explorer.

Old enemies, Maggie and Negan, travel to a crumbling, post-apocalyptic Manhattan to fulfill a dangerous mission; filled with the dead and living dwellers, New York City has been transformed into a world full of chaos, danger, terror and beauty.
Mythic creatures emerge from the sea to feast on the residents of a fishing village.

The film showcases three 14-year-old girls: Dawn (Miriam McDonald), Becca (Megan Park), and Hannah (Alexis Dziena). Hannah soon finds herself on the receiving end of peer pressure from her friends to engage in oral sex with Nick Hartman, a nice boy whom Hannah likes. She believes that she has to behave in a particular fashion in order to fit in with her more sexually-active peers.

Female US president Sheridan is killed from a mile by a masterly sniper who leaves no trace. The vice-president, now having succeeded for a short end of term, is contested by her brother, governor Wally Sheridan, who plays the national insecurity card, as the murder is only the first of series of terrorist strikes. Colonel Amos and his team are given a free hand to track down and catch the killer at all cost. Ross Tanner, who is found by a retired couple and lovingly nursed after a bad fall from a helicopter, comes to realize trough serious amnesia he's probably the sniper. Two teams track him down. La Mangouste's commando team kills the couple, tortures him and anyone known to have crossed his path but looses him again. General Carrington tells him his identity is an elaborate fake to intrude the conspiracy which uses the collateral victims at every terrorist strike, all tattooed with Roman numerals, like his XIII.

US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

"The Zoo: San Diego" provides a behind the scenes look at the daily lives of various species of animals and the teams that care for them. Featuring two parks, the San Diego Zoo and the San Diego Zoo Safari Park, as well as the San Diego Zoo Institute for Conservation Research, San Diego Zoo Global is home to more than 700 species and 6,500 animals. A wide range of animals are introduced, including pandas, giraffes, Galapagos tortoises, koalas, elephants, mountain lions, two baby cheetahs that are learning how to be ambassadors for their species and a flock of ostriches known as the "Spice Girls." Besides the animals, the keepers and veterinarians at both the Zoo and the Safari Park -- many of whom have dedicated their lives to caring for animals, discuss what it's like to be a part of this world-renowned zoo.

This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

A cat and dog have been handed over to the SPCA by their owner, both are suffering from life threatening injures and illness. When the SPCA investigates, it's bad news. The SPCA receives an report of 2 abandoned puppies on a property on the bad side of town. When a heatwave strikes the city, one dog is in danger of heatstroke when left outside with no shade or water. A pregnant pitbull is discovered living in unsuitable conditions.

Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

The Project Grizzly series follows the trials and tribulations of world renowned bear trainer Jeff Watson as he battles against time to teach his rescued grizzlies the skills and tricks needed for them to survive back in the wild where they truly belong. The domesticated grizzlies Bob and Screech learn to live outside the cage, to fish, to hunt and to live in the wild. Raised by him since cubs, Jeff's decision is not only emotionally charged but emotive in the message it gives of a 'father's' love to do the best for his young.

Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

p.t: Insane Pools Off the Deep End
p.d: Insane Pools: Off the Deep End is a home improvement show that follows pool designer Lucas Congdon and his team from Lucas Lagoons. Congdon and his crew renovate existing pools and build new ones on residential properties. Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

The Wattersons try and reconnect Darwin to his fish roots. When Mom sees Darwin gazing longingly at a fish-tank she thinks their mammalian lifestyle isn't fulfilling her adopted son and deep down he longs to connect with his fishy roots. So the family try to re-connect him with his aquatic culture; they try fish-food fish-language even fish clothes. But when none of it works they realize they may have to let him go.

p.t: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball‌
p.d: In Elmore, reality bends and family life gets weird. Gumball pulls Darwin, Anais, and the whole town into adventures - from fighting evil fast food to dealing with an AI crushing on his mom. The show's so wild, it needed a new name.

Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

Drew Pritchard and Paul Cowland travel across the United Kingdom to uncover classic cars to buy, restore and sell on for a profit. The pair scour garages, barns and facilities to discover collectible cars which include the likes of the Morris Minor Traveller, Jaguar XJS, Rover P6 and a BMW 635 CSI among many others. The combination of Drew's expertise of negotiation and deal-making and Paul's extensive mechanical knowledge makes them a formidable team ready to tackle anything challenging that comes their way.

Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

Motorbike enthusiast Henry Cole and expert Sam Lovegrove travel around the UK to explore people's sheds searching for some automotive bargains. They purchase all kinds of old cars, bikes, jeeps, tractors and other vehicles in order to renovate them and sell after the rehabilitation work is over. The old vehicles are restored and given second life. It is a risky business and the two always wonder if they manage to make profit this time.

For many, an ideal existence is as far away from the bustling boulevards and city streets as is physically possible, opting to live in a serene and secluded corner of our planet. This documentary series follows teams of adventuring builders as they construct magnificent and unique properties in far-flung corners of our planet. Battling against adverse conditions, limited budgets and narrow deadlines, these crews strive to get their structures erected in time. From mountain cabins to woodland yurts, shipping container homes to lighthouse conversions, these stunning properties show the true meaning of living off the grid.

Documentary series that follows the work of some of the world's biggest and most highly-skilled shippers, who are responsible for keeping the world's cargo ships on the move 365 days a year. There are at least 20 million shipping containers crossing the world's seas at any given time as 90% of world trade is transported by water and, as mega ships now dominate global waters, big money is at stake. From shipping tens of thousands of luxury cars, multi-million dollar yachts, to a 20 ton shipment of sweet potatoes, the audience will have a chance to see ground crews use precision engineering, top-of-the-line machinery, and nerves of steel to on-load and off-load these precious, but very different cargoes, conquering various on-the-spot challenges from miscalculations to malfunctions.

Follow husband and wife team Justin and Anna Scribner as they crisscross the country seeking out vintage RVs and trailers to transform into luxury homes on wheels. They'll search through trailer graveyards to find a hidden gem that has been put out to RV pasture, then haul it back to their shop in Bend, Oregon to give it a full overall. And when Justin and Anna restore these RVs to even better than their former glory, you won't believe your eyes.

In Texas, four competing car dealers, JD Cole, Martha Davis, Ash Rabah, and Tommy Spagnola, battle it out to get the best deals and profits for their businesses. The cars bought, fixed-up and sold on range from many different eras, brands and variants. Some of which include classic muscle cars such as the Pontiac Trans Am and Chevrolet El Camino, to European cults like the Alfa Romeo Spider, Mercedes SL and Volkswagen Beetle. The aim of the game is to get the cars at knock-down prices, restore them to former glory and flip them for a healthy profit. Find out which dealer comes out on top.

Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

Travel Thru History (or TTH for short) is a new educational/informational (E/I) series designed to spark interest and enthusiasm in viewers to learn about our country's rich and fascinating history by traveling to diverse locales across the US. While it is targeted to a teen audience, the entire family will enjoy watching TTH. Videotaped and edited in the style of other popular, educational programming like Modern Marvels, Travel Thru History is the latest television series co-developed by The Television Syndication Company and Red 5 Creative.

The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?
Annual brood stock fishery from Percy Walkus Hatchery in Wuikinuxv, Rivers Inlet...conserving the largest Chinook on Earth!

Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town!

Vēlāk izmeklētāju izredzes notvert vainīgo sarūk uz pusi. Raidījums ļauj ielūkoties ASV slepkavību izmeklētāju ikdienā, kuri neatlaidīgi strādā, lai jau pirmajās nozieguma izdarīšanas stundās atklātu pēc iespējas vairāk detaļu par ļaunprātības apstākļiem. Skatītājus sagaida reāls izmeklēšanas process, liecinieku intervijas, kriminālistiskās ekspertīzes aizkulises un iespēja ielūkoties vietās, kur nupat pastrādāts noziegums.

Lai satiktos ar meitenēm, Bads nodibina savu koledžas brālību "Alpha Gonna Get'Em", kuras statūtos vienīgie locekļi ir hinduistu veikala pārdevējs Ahmeds, gīks Franciss un pensionārs Gass. Pirmajā biedrības ballītē Bandiju garāžā pietrūkst ne vien jautrība, bet arī sievietes.

Vēlēšanu dienā visi Bandiji (izņemot Sevenu) devušies balsot. Vienoti, lai uzvarētu politkorektumu un jaunu alus nodokli. Kad viņu favorīti balsojumā zaudē, Bandiji iziet ielās, lai veiktu labu vecmodīgu laupīšanu.

Ofisā, kura darbinieki nodarbojas ar papīra pārdošanu un piegādi, viss ir tāpat kā lielākajā daļā pasaules ofisu - tajā ir boss, tajā ir dažādi darbinieki, no kuriem dažs labs vien darbu tikai imitē, un starp visiem izveidojušās ofisa attiecības tādā kā piespiedu kārtā - labākas un arī ne tik labas. Kā jau ar kolēģiem. Ofisa vadītājs Maikls, kuru attēlo slavenais aktieris un komiķis Stīvs Karels, savus darbiniekus ik dienas cenšas iesaistīt savos izgudrotajos jokos un uzdevumos. Viņš pats domā, ka ir pasaules labākais boss, ko apliecina krūzīte ar uzrakstu - "Pasaules labākais boss". Diemžēl šo krūzīti viņš sev nopircis pats. Maikls cenšas būt draudzīgs pret saviem darbiniekiem, tomēr lielākā daļa viņa joku ir rasistiski, šovinistiski vai citādi aizskaroši.

Ofisā, kura darbinieki nodarbojas ar papīra pārdošanu un piegādi, viss ir tāpat kā lielākajā daļā pasaules ofisu - tajā ir boss, tajā ir dažādi darbinieki, no kuriem dažs labs vien darbu tikai imitē, un starp visiem izveidojušās ofisa attiecības tādā kā piespiedu kārtā - labākas un arī ne tik labas. Kā jau ar kolēģiem. Ofisa vadītājs Maikls, kuru attēlo slavenais aktieris un komiķis Stīvs Karels, savus darbiniekus ik dienas cenšas iesaistīt savos izgudrotajos jokos un uzdevumos. Džūlsa cenšas izprast nerakstītos likumus par noslēpumu glabāšanu draudzeņu lokā, kas rada problēmas Medisonei darbā. Savukārt Stella mēģina iemācīt Izijai būt noslēpumainākai.

Draudzenes mēģina tikt skaidrībā ar saviem personīgajiem "brendiem". Džūlsa un Stella uzņemas "garlaicīgās" un "jautrās" lomas. Medisone, "valdonīgā", palīdz Izijai, "trakajai", atbrīvoties no uzspēlētās identitātes.

В почтовое отделение на должность экспедитора устраивается Елена (40 лет). Экспедитор Андрей (45) не очень доволен новой напарницей, он не доверяет женщинам за рулем. Но со временем между Еленой и Андреем возникает симпатия. И не без стараний со стороны их детей – Юли и Глеба. Андрей – одинокий папа, Елена - одинокая мама, казалось бы, ничего не может помешать их отношениям… Но тайны и ошибки прошлого сыграют с ними злую шутку… Бушуют страсти и в почтовом отделении. Руководитель отделения Артем (30) покоряет вершины почтовой карьеры и не желает замечать сотрудницу отделения Милану (25), которая мечтает заполучить его сердце. Мама Артема и его младший брат Гена также вносят в жизнь отделения свои коррективы… Все герои ежедневно сталкиваются с нестандартными ситуациями, но не остаются равнодушными к проблемам людей-клиентов почтового отделения, помогая им выпутаться из сложных историй…

Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

Успешная бизнес-леди Катя узнает, что её дочь пыталась покончить жизнь самоубийством. Как оказалось, не впервые. Чтобы быть ближе к дочери и понять, чем на самом деле занимаются дети в школе, она начинает работать учительницей экономики. Молодая мама понятия не имела, какие секреты скрываются за стенами обычной школы. Тогда же в учебное заведение приходит новый преподаватель английского - бывший адвокат и сын директора Алекс. У него есть невеста, которая живет в США, но вдруг между ним и Екатериной промелькнула искра. Впрочем, скелеты прошлого всё ещё дают о себе знать и не отпускают героев...

Оля Мельникова работает переводчицей в брачном агентстве "Шанс". Она ведет переписку от имени женщин, которые мечтают выйти замуж за иностранцев. Ее тексты пользуются успехом. Сама же девушка о любви не думает. Как преданная сестра, она заботится о старшем брате Борисе, прикованного к инвалидной коляске. Однажды, получив очередное задание от вздорной и самовлюбленной клиентки Анжелы, Оля вступает в переписку с молодым англичанином Генри. Вскоре главная героиня понимает, что влюблена в человека, который и не догадывается о ее существовании.

When Eleroo advises Bumblelion to make a wish when getting the biggest part of the wishbone, it means trouble for poor Rhinokey for losing two bank bags of money. Bumblelion starts spending the money and looses his friends while Rhinokey manages to escape from Officer Eaglebeagle. Rhinokey tries to convince Bumblelion to return the bank bags, but Bumblelion decides to run off thinking that Rhinokey wants to steal his money. Soon after, Bumblelion realizes how Rhinokey lost the bank bags and returns the money to the police.

In a humble village on the edge of the jungle, a young boy strays from his mother to play with a monkey. Lost in the jungle, he is saved by the great elephant, who will raise him as a member of the great family of animals. When he grows up he helps to protect the jungle from a ruthless poacher.

Ever since his wife died, David struggles to get on with his teenage daughter Jules. She feels hemmed in and misunderstood, and he finds himself more and more powerless and lonely. In order to find a new partner for her dad and someone to talk to for herself, Jules creates online profiles on dating sites for David. Things suddenly take a funny turn, because although there is no shortage of candidates, they all fall short of David's ... and Jules's expectations. Will everything take a fresh turn on Christmas? A funny, heartwarming story in a wonderful Xmas mood!
A boy rises to the occasion with his best friend (a lovable talking dog) to save his home and family.

Seventeen-year-old Farley has led a sheltered life, raised on a diet of home schooling, organic living and trips to the art gallery. To his parents' dismay, Farley loves to play hockey with the local kids. To their even greater dismay, Farley is scouted and signed by the owner of a junior league team, where he becomes an instant star. But Farley discovers that stardom comes with a price - including the expectation to fight on the ice. Throw in a changing relationship with his best friend, and Farley finds himself losing his way.

A hard-working cupcake maker is inadvertently elected mayor of a small town burdened with debt. With no formal experience or education to speak of, she must rely on her street smarts to clean up the town.

p.t: The Old Man and the Gun
p.d: David Lowery's crime biopic stars Robert Redford as Forrest Tucker, a real-life bank robber who found himself wanted by police across the United States for a string of prison escapes and robberies. We first meet Tucker in the early 80s. He's 74 and has been evading police for two years since his last audacious prison break. But he's not taking things easy and laying low. That's not his bag. This suave old geezer has a somehow enamouring way of walking into a bank, charmingly informing the teller that he has a gun that he doesn't want to use, and walking out with a big old sack of cash. In fact, he's just done exactly that when he meets Jewel (Sissy Spacek), an enchanting farmer who he quickly trusts so much that he decides to reveal to her his true identity. Tucker, alongside spending time on Jewel's farm enjoying her more simplistic way of life, embarks on a string of heists. On the case is local detective John Hunt (Casey Affleck), and Tucker soon finds himself torn between the peaceful life he's enjoyed with Jewel and his old criminal ways. Also starring Danny Glover and Tom Waits.

p.t: 10 Things We Should Do Before We Break Up
p.d: Abigail, a self-sufficient single mom meets Ben. They both think every great relationship ends in disaster. On the first date they come up with 10 things to do together before they break up. But the estimated end is not so sure - because fate adds #11 to their list.
Orson, a compulsive bureaucrat who discovers a secret room.

Kevin, Samantha and Rob live for Foolproof; their own private club where through high-tech, meticulously thought out and executed plans, they pull off the most impossible of heists - all in theory that is. They've never actually done it for real. But all that changes when Leo, a cutthroat British gangster, rips off their foolproof plans for a diamond heist and uses it to successfully execute the robbery. Threatening to implicate them, Leo blackmails them to pull off a robbery worth $20 million in corporate bonds.

Jean Barreau leads a spiritual commune on the countryside with the promise of a second life. When their doubles arrive at the house, his followers learn that Jean meant this promise quite literally. However, not everybody is as easily swayed by their capricious leader, who eventually starts to question his own beliefs.

A discount store clerk strikes up an affair with a stock boy who considers himself the incarnation of Holden Caulfield.Justine is a sullen 30-year-old woman stuck in a dead-end job at the Retail Rodeo department store.In addition to her mind-numbing occupation, Justine also has to contend with her dim-witted husband, Phil, and his partner, Bubba, who work as house painters when they aren't smoking pot and staring blankly at the television.Justine sees an opportunity for change, however, when she meets Holden, a fellow Retail Rodeo employee who is even more depressed than herself.The young Holden and Justine soon begin a passionate secret affair, unaware that it may not be so secret after all.

American drama, produced in 2004. An American, French, German, Italian, Rumanian, and British co-production. The story of Amedeo Modigliani's bitter rivalry with Pablo Picasso, and his tragic romance with Jeanne Hebuterne.

This film is about a hyper-vigilant employee of the department of public safety who, while training his young female replacement, has to track down a missing girl who he is convinced is connected to a paroled sex offender he is investigating.

Samir, must face his parent's breakup. While they meet to find the way to tell him, the little Samir surprises them, because he knows perfectly what's happening, putting his own parents into a hard place with his vision of the situation.

Eiženija ir meistarīga pavāre, kura jau vairāk nekā 20 gadus strādā pie izsmalcināta gardēža Dodēna. Laika gaitā viņu sadarbība pāraugusi romantiskās attiecībās, kas iedvesmo gardus ēdienus, par kuriem sajūsminās pat pasaules izcilākie šefpavāri. Tomēr, neraugoties uz Dodēna uzstājību, Eiženija nesteidzas teikt viņam jāvārdu. Lai mīļoto pārliecinātu, Dodēns nolemj sākt gatavot maltītes viņai.

Pēc tam, kad ienaidnieki iznīcina kādu ciematu Sudānā, bārenis Teo, viņa brāļi, māsas un vietējie ciematiņa iedzīvotāji pārceļas uz bēgļu nometni Kenijā. Pagājuši trīspadsmit gadi kopš šausminošā notikušā, un dzīve viņiem piespēlē nebijušu iespēju - pārcelties uz dzīvi ASV. Kanzasā viņus sagaida nodarbinātības aģentūras darbiniece Kerija Deivisa. Tikšanās ar šo dāmu izmainīs bēgļu dzīves uz visiem laikiem un liks viņu acīs iemirdzēties cerībai par labāku nākotni. Galvenajā lomā Rīza Viterspūna.

Filmā "Ofēlija", kas veidota pēc Lisas Klainas romāna, Ofēlija, slavenā Šekspīra lugas "Hamlets" varone, vēsta savu versiju par to, kā patiesībā risinājās lugā aprakstītie notikumi. Ofēliju, dumpīgo, bez mātes augušo meiteni, pieņem audzināšanā karaliene Ģertrūde. Viņā iemīlas Ģertrūdes dēls princis Hamlets, un viņi slepus apprecas laikā, kad Dānijas karaļvalsti apdraud norvēģu iebrukums un galma iekšienē vērptās intrigas. Ofēlijai un Hamletam ir jāizvēlas starp mīlestību un atriebības alkām.
Vientuļās mātes dzīve tiek sagrauta - pilsētā atgriežas viņas grūtībās nonākušais, reti redzētais jaunākais brālis.

Bijušo meksikāņu "federale"" ar segvārdu Mačete nodod viņa darba devējs un vēlas viņu nogalināt... Tomēr neticamā veidā Mačete izglābjas. Ar sava drauga, priestera Benito del Toro palīdzību, kurš drauga dēļ ir gatavs atsacīties no nenogalināšanas zvēresta, Mačete dodas asiņainā atriebes ceļojumā. Tajā viņš nežēlo nevienu, kurš stājas viņam pretī. Un, protams, pa ceļam Mačete pagūst apliecināt savu brunču mednieka statusu.

Aleksandra Dimā leģendārā vēsturiskā piedzīvojumu romāna ekranizācijas otrā daļa. D'Artanjana acu priekšā tiek nolaupīta Konstance. Lai glābtu mīļoto, musketieris ir spiests apvienot spēkus ar bezbailīgo un nežēlīgo Milēdiju. Taču karalisti sašķēluši reliģiskie kari un sācies Anglijas iebrukums. Atoss, Portoss un Aramiss jau ir pievienojušies frontei, un kāds sens noslēpums sagrauj vecās alianses.
Seriāls stāsta par četriem bijušajiem ASV armijas specvienības karavīriem, kuri, netaisnīgi apsūdzēti noziegumā, bēg no militārās policijas un palīdz cilvēkiem, kuri nonākuši nelaimē.

p.t: Trīs paziņojumi pie Ebingas Misūri štatā
p.d: Mildredas Heizas meita Andžela tika izvarota un noslepkavota pirms vairāk nekā pusgada, taču slepkavības izmeklēšana nevirzās uz priekšu. Mildreda sper izmisīgu un pārdrošu soli - uz ceļa, kura malā Andžela tika atrasta, viņa uz reklāmas stendiem izvieto trīs paziņojumus, kas adresēti Ebingas pilsētiņas šerifam Viljamam Vilobijam. Policija uzskata šo par kara pieteikumu un dara visu, lai paziņojumi tiktu aizvākti. Taču Mildreda nedomā padoties, un spriedze tikai pieaug.

Henrija dzīve izmainās vienā acumirklī - lai palīdzētu paziņām, viņš dodas uz sporta spēli, taču izrādās, ka viņš nolūkots par šoferi bankas aplaupīšanā. Nonācis cietumā un iepazinies ar asprātīgo Maksu, kurš cietumu uzskata par savām mājām, par labu uzvedību Henrijs drīz tiek brīvībā, lai beidzot izdarītu ko paliekošu. Nu viņš ir nolēmis aplaupīt to pašu banku, par kuras neaplaupīšanu jau sēdēja nebrīvē, un par kompanjonu Henrijs ir nolūkojis Maksu. Taču iejaucas Amors, kurš savu bultu raida untumainās un karstasinīgās Džulas virzienā, un šī sieviete ir aktrise teātrī, kas, kā runā, pa pazemi ar savienots ar Henrija noskatīto banku.
Viņš ir leģenda, viņš ir superzvaigzne, viņš ir hītu autors. Viņa talants, karjera un skandāli vienaldzīgu neatstāj nevienu. Viņš ir Robijs Viljamss un viņa veiksmes talismans ir pērtiķis.
Pēc veiksmīgas gladiatoru izbēgšanas Spartaks vada atbrīvoto vergu armiju, vienlaikus izvēloties starp personīgo atriebību pret Romas ģenerāli Glāberu un cīņu par brīvību.

Uz patiesiem notikumiem balstīta filma par lidmašīnas nolaupīšanu un ķīlnieku krīzi. 1976. gadā tika nolaupīta Air France lidmašīna, kas bija ceļā no Telavivas uz Parīzi caur Atēnām un piespiesta nosēsties Entebē, Ugandā. Pasažieri, kas bija ebreji, tika atdalīti no pārējiem, turēti kā ķīlnieki, un nolaupītāji pieprasīja atbrīvot teroristus, kas ieslodzīti Izraēlas cietumos. Pēc garām debatēm Izraēlas valdība uz Entebi nosūtīja elites vienību, lai atbrīvotu ķīlniekus.

Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

Two talented chefs go head-to-head for the chance to Beat Bobby Flay. To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

With her boys out for the day, Elizabeth treats herself to her favourite sweet potato ravioli and molasses lace cookies with white chocolate filling.
Maneet Chauhan is cooking up her signature shortcut recipe for a classic chicken tikka masala, followed by a vegetarian feast of aloo gobi.
The returning champ faces off against Hanna Haar and Gustavo Romero in a nut-fuelled challenge where bold risks and big flavours are the way forward.

Featuring 24 talented and fearless chefs who take on 24 food challenges in 24 consecutive, non-stop hours, the 24-hour competition takes the chefs to the extreme, demanding they display the skills, creativity and stamina needed to be an elite chef.

In Food Network's series Kids Baking Championship, hosts and judges Duff Goldman and Valerie Bertinelli will lead eight talented kid bakers through challenges designed to find the most-impressive and creative young baker. In each challenge the contestants, ranging in age from 10 to 13, will be tested on their baking skills and originality as they whip up delectable desserts, including creative cakes, mouthwatering cookies and pastries.

Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

Mailss Moraless atgriežas uz ekrāniem nākamajā ar Oskaru apbalvotās Zirnekļpasaules sāgas nodaļā. Varenais piedzīvojums nogādās Zirnekļcilvēku no Bruklinas draudzīgās apkaimes pāri Zirnekļpasaulei, lai viņš apvienotu spēkus ar Gvenu Steisiju un jauno zirnekļļaužu komandu un stātos pretī ļaundarim, par kuru spēcīgāku viņi vēl nav satikuši.
Laipni lūdzam smurfu pasaulē! Burvis Gargamels ir piespiedis smurfus bēgt no dzimtā ciema. Ģimenes komēdija, kurā animācijas filmas varoņi parādās spēlfilmā.
Kādam mazpilsētas tēvam jāatrod drosme un pārliecība pastāstīt pasaulei par sava mazā dēla īpašo, dzīvi mainošo pieredzējumu.

Pasaulslaveno pirmdienu nīdēju un lazanjas mīlētāju mājas kaķi Garfīldu gaida vājprātīgi jautrs piedzīvojums brīvā dabā! Negaidīti saticis savu sen zudušo tēvu, noplukušo ielas kaķi Viku, Gārfīlds kopā ar savu draugu, suni Odiju, ir spiests pamest ideālo lutekļa dzīvi un piebiedroties Vikam pārgalvīgā laupīšanā.

Ir 1613. gads, un Šekspīrs jau novērtēts kā šī laikmeta lieliskākais rakstnieks. Tomēr notiek traģēdija, un viņa slavenais Globe teātris Londonā nodeg līdz pašiem pamatiem. Saguris Šekspīrs atgriežas Stretfordā, kur viņam jāsaskaras ar savu smago pagātni un nolaidīgo ģimeni. Sava vienīgā dēla Hamneta nāves vajāts, viņam ir grūtības salabot attiecības ar ģimeni. Tomēr, to cenšoties, viņš ir spiests atkal un atkal izvērtēt savas neveiksmes.

Stāsts par Pīteru Pārkeru, vienaudžu izstumtu vidusskolnieku, ko pametuši vecāki un uzaudzinājuši tēvocis Bens un tante Meja. Pīters cenšas atrast savu vietu dzīvē un rast iespēju būt kopā ar savu pirmo skolas mīlestību Gvenu. Kad Pīters atrod noslēpumainu koferi, kas piederējis viņa tēvam, viņš sāk saprast savu vecāku pazušanas iemeslus un nonāk uz pēdām doktoram Kurtam Konorsam, kas ir viņa tēva bijušais biznesa partneris. Drīz vien Pīteram nākas pieņemt izšķirošus lēmumus un likt lietā savu spēku un spējas, lai kļūtu par to, ko viņam lēmis liktenis, - par varoni.

Visnozīmīgākā cīņa Zirnekļcilvēkam notiek viņā pašā – bezgalīga sacensība starp Pītera Parkera ikdienišķiem pienākumiem un Zirnekļcilvēka milzīgo atbildību. Taču kulta blokbastera turpinājumā mēs noskaidrosim, ka nākotnē Pīteru gaida daudz nopietnāka kauja un būt Zirnekļcilvēkam joprojām ir tikpat forši.

Nelidojošie dusmīgie putni joprojām karo ar viltīgajām zaļajām cūkām. Viņi ir ļaunākie ienaidnieki, un, šķiet, nekas nespēs to mainīt. Taču, kad pie apvāršņa parādās jaunas briesmas, kas apdraud viņus visus, putniem un cūkām nāksies apvienoties, lai glābtu savas mājas.
Izdzīvojusi Grenlandes bunkurā, Garitiju ģimene dodas pāri sagrautai Eiropai, lai atrastu jaunas mājas.

Maks (Sets Rogens) un Kellija (Roza Bairna) gaida otru bērnu un nolemj pārvākties uz citurieni. Viņu plānam traucē Šelbija (Hloja Greisa Moreca), kura mēģina nodibināt studenšu klubu, lai viņa ar draugiem varētu rīkot savas ballītes. Abas grupas drīzumā kļūst par zvērinātiem ienaidniekiem, jo atšķiras to uzskati par skaļu mūziku un nepārtrauktu dzerstiņu. Maks un Kellija drīz sauc palīgā bijušo ienaidnieku Tediju (Zaks Efrons), lai neļautu kubam "Kappa Nu" turpināt traucēt dzīvi apkārtnē.

Filmas sižets balstīts patiesos notikumus un atgādina par autosporta vēstures spriedzes pilnām lapaspusēm. Notikumi risinās 60. gados, kad konstruktoru grupa, kuru vadīja Kerols Šelbijs, kopā ar britu sacīkšu braucēju Kenu Mailsu uzbūvēja vēl nebijušu "Ford" sporta automašīnu un meta izaicinājumu Lemānas 24 stundu sacīkšu favorītam "Ferrari".
Edijs un Venoms ir metušies bēgt. Viņus vajā abas viņu pasaules, tāpēc neparastais duets ir spiesti pieņemt sarežģītu lēmumu, kā ietekmē sākas Venoma un Edija pēdējā deja.

Animācijas filma "Lego" klucīšu stilā par Farela Viljamsa dzīvi. Filmā, kurā galvenās lomas ierunājis pats Farels Viljamss (Pharrell Williams), kā arī Kendriks Lamārs (Kendrick Lamar) un Džastins Timberleiks (Justin Timberlake), ķieģelīti pa ķieģelītim tiek pārskatīta mākslinieka karjera.

Žoslēns ir veiksmīgs biznesmenis, toties mīlas dzīvē – patmīlīgs brunču mednieks. Kad viņš mēģina jau atkal savaldzināt jaunu sievieti, izliekoties, ka ir ratiņkrēslā, viņa iepazīstina Žoslēnu ar savu māsu, kura patiešām piesaistīta dzīvei ratiņkrēslā.

Monstru ģimene šoreiz dodas brīvdienās. Luksusa kruīza kuģis aizvedīs Drakulu prom no rūpēm par viesnīcas apmeklētāju labsajūtu. Un kas ir atpūta bez draugiem, kuri tāpat ar prieku metas baudīt kuģa sniegtās izklaides! Taču, kad Drakula iemīlas noslēpumainajā kapteinē Ērikā, viņš vēl nenojauš, ka Ērika ir monstru lielākā ienaidnieka Ābrahama van Helsinga pēctece un sākas mošķu cienīga drāma.

p.d: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

p.d: Maddie Moate explores unique homes across the globe which reflect their owners' personalities, passions and philosophies for life. These visionaries dared to dream, build, and live differently, challenging the way we see home.

Maria Morris takes on the world of real estate in Dubai. From high-rise condos to palatial villas, she'll stop at nothing to find her clients the perfect home.

Recent lottery winners look for their perfect dream house in this "House Hunters"-inspired reality show. David Bromstad takes recent lottery winners on over-the-top house hunts for their new dream homes. Whether they win hundreds of thousands or hundreds of millions, lucky lottery winners everywhere are jumping headfirst into the real estate market. Will they spend all their winnings on an extravagant mansion or settle for a humble sound investment? Find out what happens when average Americans set out to find "My Lottery Dream Home".

Dave and Jenny renovate a tornado-ravaged house for their child's preschool teacher. They're looking to create a beautiful space with thoughtful design, and with a storm shelter and play areas, the makeover helps the family feel safe and at home.

Designer Michel Smith Boyd uses clever budget hacks to help homeowners create luxurious renovations without stretching their bank accounts. Along with his creative team, Michel brings upscale design within reach to deliver beautifully overhauled spaces in the Atlanta, Georgia area.

Rico León gets in to help Denver homeowners salvage renovations that have went off the rails; driven by his parents' past experience with a crooked contractor, he advocates for families who are in need of an expert to fix their stressful situations

A family of seven hired a builder to renovate their kitchen, but he went missing soon after demolition. Rico steps in and takes charge of the project, and he uncovers disturbing information and a dark past while tracking down the old contractor.

A couple loves the newly-renovated front of their historic home, but the back of the house still needs some updating. Georgia and Richie revamp the cramped kitchen, living room and backyard to create a flow for effortless entertaining.

Georgia and Richie revamp a dated bungalow for clients who need a modern makeover. They must incorporate a functional and practical design into a house with only one toilet for a family of five, while remaining environmentally conscious.

American reality series following host Suzanne Whang on her quest to help people relocate in search of their dream home. Follow the individuals, couples and families in an international search for their perfect property, exploring a stunning selection of homes chosen just for them. With three potential candidates to choose from, join them as they try and make the difficult decision to start a new life abroad. Revisit the new homeowners at the end of each episode to see how their properties have developed and how life has changed for them since the move.
A couple's ready to go from two homes to one in Wilton Manors, Florida. They're looking for a great water view with yard space for their pups.

Contractor Russell Holmes helps clients get their stalled renos back on track using ingenious, dollar-stretching solutions. With some help from designer Paige Poupart, he'll find compromises that make the most-ambitious home improvement dreams a reality.

From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

From a bat swung by one of baseball's boldest pioneers, to an iconic painting hidden behind a false wall, and even a relic tied to our nation's first president, these finds prove that America's treasures can turn up in the most unlikely places.

Human bones as a "miracle cure" for gout? Living mummies buried alive? A truly bizarre Victorian way to lose weight with tapeworms? From daily rites to once-in-a-lifetime rituals, the stranger side of human nature is revealed in these rituals.

One of the most infamous pirates to prowl America's Gulf Coast--Jean Lafitte--led what may have been the largest pirate fleet in the world. Known as "The Terror of the Gulf" he was more than a pirate... he was a crime boss, rich beyond belief, and just as ruthless. But the whereabouts of Jean Lafitte's treasure remain unknown. The swamps and bayous were his base, and likely also his hiding place. But treasure hunters have found very little of Lafitte's stash.

Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

From a bat swung by one of baseball's boldest pioneers, to an iconic painting hidden behind a false wall, and even a relic tied to our nation's first president, these finds prove that America's treasures can turn up in the most unlikely places.

Human bones as a "miracle cure" for gout? Living mummies buried alive? A truly bizarre Victorian way to lose weight with tapeworms? From daily rites to once-in-a-lifetime rituals, the stranger side of human nature is revealed in these rituals.

In the climax of the investigation, the head of the team leads a search of two marshes in the heart of Bogota that are listed in the declassified FBI files as being the location of a submerged plane that transported Hitler to the area. Using historical maps and cutting edge technology the team corroborates information from the FBI file and finds evidence of a suspicious object buried deep in the mud of a marsh matching the description within the files, which could be a plane!

Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

p.t: Lost Relics of the Knights Templar
p.d: Lost Relic Hunters follows the work of one of the world's most prolific collectors of antiquities, Hamilton White, and his long-time friend and business partner, Carl Cookson. The intrepid duo are back on the trail of some truly astonishing relics and historical pieces, which, if authenticated, will potentially change our understanding of some of the most iconic periods of British and European history. Aided in their adventures by cultural and art historian Dr Janina Ramirez, Lost Relic Hunters sees Carl and Hamilton journey to breath-taking locations around the world including Venice, Istanbul, Barcelona, Jerusalem and the Pyrenees, in their quest to authenticate the rare and precious antiquities from Hamilton's collection.

Legends of lost and mysterious islands, advanced civilizations and Eden-like paradises have been told by sailors throughout human history. Is it possible these stories are more than just the myths of imaginative seafarers? Might evidence of our Ancient Alien origins be found by exploring the world's most remote islands--strategic spots where extraterrestrials may have once made their earthly homes... and possibly still visit today? Unidentified submersible objects going at lightning speed... strange crafts coming out of water near remote volcanic islands... and mystifying megalithic ruins in the middle of the ocean. Is it possible UFO activity could be hidden deep underwater and off the coasts of islands? Could this explain why so many islands around the world have stories of unexplained sightings of objects both overhead and beneath the sea going back centuries?

In an international UFO hotspot, Lue Elizondo uncovers exclusive video of a glowing orb recorded recently by an airline pilot at 35,000 feet and investigates possible connections to secret technology related to the USSR, plus a shocking aerial battle between a jet fighter pilot and an UFO. Local people reveal an ancient connection, as high-ranking officials drop a Project Blue Book bombshell. The planetary threat of UFOS is explored.

The team's access to UFO evidence is unparalleled and their expertise allows them to quickly identify bogus claims of UFOs. Together, they use eyewitness accounts, scientific experimentation, documents recently released through the Freedom of Information Act and footage that has never been seen before on television to piece together compelling — and at times chilling — evidence of UFO phenomena. Join UFO Hunters Bill Birnes, Pat Uskert, Dr. Ted Acworth, and Jeff Tomlinson as they separate fact from fallacy.

In the search for life beyond our planet, this documentary investigates areas on earth that are said to have had UFO activity, conspiracy theories and phenomenons. Interviewing a variety of scientists and experts on UFOs and examining when possible evidence can prove or suggest anything towards super natural life. From going off of tales that have been told and spread through generations and or cultures to personal experiences where sighting have occurred the series covers the super natural phenomenon that is life beyond earth.

As we all know, the initial verdict in a trial is not always the final outcome as many trial jury decisions are often overturned on appeal. However, the appeals process can take a significant amount of time to go through the system and also incur enormous costs on the individuals involved. This show follows the work of two investigators who re-examine the verdicts in contentious murder cases and assess the prospects of a successful appeal for the families of the people convicted of the crimes to determine if they should appeal or accept the verdict. Each episode traces the developments in the case, whether it be new evidence or witness testimony, which can then shed light on the innocence of the convicted person or show that, indeed, they are guilty of the crime and the verdict was correct.
